Subject: Ecosys Health: reference interview — availability & recording consent

Hi Ayesha,

Thanks again for agreeing to speak with us about how Ecosys Health is using Redwood Inference — much appreciated. We want to schedule a 45-minute discovery-style interview with 2–3 of your stakeholders to capture the product impact and use cases for a short case study (written + 90s customer quote video).

High-level asks:
- 45 minutes on video (we request permission to record audio + video for internal capture and the marketing snippet)
- A short agenda (see attached proposed-agenda.odt)
- We’ll send a one-page consent form to capture media rights and quotes (attached: ecosys-reference-consent-form.pdf)

Proposed time windows (Pacific TZ) — please let us know which slot works or share alternatives:
- Tue May 4, 10:00–10:45am PT
- Wed May 5, 1:00–1:45pm PT
- Thu May 6, 9:00–9:45am PT

Participants we’d like (happy to adjust):
- Ayesha Khan — Product Lead (your side)
- Martin Liu — Data/ML Lead (your side)
- Jonas Weber — Solutions, Redwood
- Marissa Cole — Customer Stories, Redwood
If there are any internal policies or an optional NDA needed before the call, flag them and we’ll loop in Legal.

Attached: proposed-agenda.odt; ecosys-reference-consent-form.pdf; availability.ics (I’ll send a calendar invite once we confirm).

Thanks — if it’s easier, reply with a preferred slot and the names/titles of any additional attendees.

Best,

Jonas Weber
Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
